sources.entry: CellarBoss - Wine inventory management system. (Source Code) GPL-3.0 Docker/Nodejs

summary.one_liner: CellarBoss is a self-hostable wine cellar and inventory manager that tracks wines, bottles, storage locations, tasting notes, and drinking windows.
summary.what_it_does: It provides a wine database with attributes such as country, region, grape, winemaker, and vintage, and lets you import wine details from a link to shops and sites like The Wine Society, Naked Wines, and Vivino. It tracks individual bottles in your inventory with per-bottle storage location, and supports storing images of your collection. It records drinking windows per vintage and lets you write tasting notes and ratings. It also includes an MCP server so AI assistants can query your cellar in natural language. The project is a monorepo with a Hono backend, a Next.js web frontend, and a React Native mobile app.
use_cases: track wine bottles in a home cellar
record tasting notes and ratings for wines
know which bottles are ready to drink
find which storage location holds a bottle
import wine details from shop or Vivino links
ask an AI assistant about my wine collection
how_to_run: Copy and configure the environment files (see docs/backend.md and docs/web.md)
pnpm auth:migrate && pnpm migrate && pnpm seed
notable: Imports wine details from shop and review-site links such as Vivino and The Wine Society
Includes an MCP server for querying the cellar from AI assistants
Supports SQLite, PostgreSQL, and MySQL according to the roadmap
Per-bottle storage location tracking with drinking window per vintage
Monorepo with separate backend, web, and mobile apps plus shared packages
caveats: Mobile app is Android-only in testing; no iOS build is currently tested, and Google Play release is pending testers
i18n and styled wine menu export are still on the roadmap, not done
No hosted version is currently planned
